title: A Lightweight Interface to Delaware Open Data APIs
text: package provides three primary functions: de_list_datasets() retrieves live catalog available Delaware Open Data datasets, including human-readable keys, Socrata UIDs, names, available metadata. de_pull_dataset() downloads cataloged datasets using either human-readable key Socrata UID, support filtering, ordering, date ranges, optional column-name cleaning, optional type coercion. de_any_dataset() downloads data directly valid Socrata JSON endpoint without requiring dataset appear package catalog. Datasets retrieved de_pull_dataset() support arguments including: limit filters date date_field order clean_names coerce_types functions return tibble outputs. Advanced users may also provide raw SoQL conditions argument. SoQL, Socrata Query Language, query syntax used Socrata-powered Open Data portals. Additional information available Socrata developer documentation.

title: Pull any Delaware Open Data dataset from a Socrata JSON endpoint — de_any_dataset
code: # Examples that hit the live Delaware Open Data API are guarded so CRAN # checks do not fail when the network is unavailable or slow. if (interactive() && curl::has_internet()) {   # Build a JSON endpoint from a Socrata UID   uid <- "yhim-4378"   endpoint <- paste0("https://data.delaware.gov/resource/", uid, ".json")    out <- try(de_any_dataset(endpoint, limit = 3), silent = TRUE)   if (!inherits(out, "try-error")) {     head(out)   } }

title: Pull a Delaware Open Data dataset — de_pull_dataset
text: catalog `key` supplied, `de_pull_dataset()` first retrieves live Delaware Open Data catalog look corresponding Socrata `uid`, sends second request download dataset . Supplying `uid` directly stable avoids ambiguity, keys provided readability classroom-friendly workflows. Dataset keys generated dataset names using [janitor::make_clean_names()]. keys derived live catalog metadata, Socrata UIDs stable identifiers. `de_pull_dataset()` designed common catalog-based workflows. arbitrary Socrata JSON endpoints included package catalog, use [de_any_dataset()]. `filters` argument intended simple exact-match filtering. complex conditions, use `` argument raw SoQL syntax. Internally, filter field names wrapped `TRIM()` constructing SoQL queries reduce mismatches caused leading trailing whitespace source data. Type coercion intentionally conservative. `coerce_types = TRUE`, package attempts infer common R column types API response, columns inconsistent values may remain character columns. Datetime coercion also conservative. Timezone offsets sub-second precision may always preserved automatic parsing, columns inconsistent datetime formats may remain character columns.

title: Pull a Delaware Open Data dataset — de_pull_dataset
code: if (interactive() && curl::has_internet()) {   # Pull by human-readable key   de_pull_dataset("recently_closed_bids", limit = 3)    # Pull by Socrata UID   de_pull_dataset("yhim-4378", limit = 3)    # Filter to one value   de_pull_dataset(     "yhim-4378",     limit = 3,     filters = list(agencycode = "AOA")   )    # Filter to multiple values   de_pull_dataset(     "yhim-4378",     limit = 10,     filters = list(agencycode = c("AOA", "ARNG"))   )    # Date filtering   de_pull_dataset(     "yhim-4378",     from = "2025-01-01",     to = "2025-06-01",     date_field = "opendate",     limit = 100   )    # Advanced filtering with raw SoQL   de_pull_dataset(     "yhim-4378",     where = "agencycode = 'HSS' AND unspsc = '8613'",     order = "opendate DESC",     limit = 100   ) }
